title: Functional Group Flashcards
author: Dr. Dan
description: Flashcards and quizzes for the 16 CHEM 3B functional groups (alkane to amide). Study mode flips cards with a key feature, a real example and where you meet it in health care; then Picture to Name, Name to Picture, Real Molecules (condensed formulas) and Mixed quizzes. Tracks mastery per group, XP and badges.
